Reranking where NVIDIA NIM lists the scored documents under rankings with a logit

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.rerankRequestFromJson("{\"documents\":[\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\",\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\"],\"model\":\"nvidia_nim/nv-rerankqa\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.rerank(_req)
debugPrint(result.results())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].relevanceScore())
```
